title: Label-Efficient Document-Grounded Factuality Detection via Cross-Paraphrastic Invariance Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.16264v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent claims that are unsupported by a given source document, motivating accurate and efficient document-grounded factuality detection. Existing LLM-based evaluators often require repeated inference and incur high computational cost, whereas compact factuality detectors are efficient at inference time but commonly rely on large labeled or synthetically generated corpora. We propose CPIL (Cross-Paraphrastic Invariance Learning), a two-stage Siamese framework that converts a small labeled set into relational supervision without acquiring additional factuality labels. CPIL constructs positive pairs from distinct label-preserving paraphrastic views of the same document-claim instance and negative pairs from opposite-label examples associated with the same source document. It further introduces quantile-aware semi-hard negative mining, which derives a boundary from the positive-pair similarity dist

translated_title: 基于跨释义不变性学习的标签高效文档事实性检测
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够生成流畅但缺乏给定源文档支持的声明，这促使人们需要准确且高效的文档事实性检测方法。现有的基于LLM的评估器通常需要重复推理且计算成本高昂，而紧凑的事实性检测器虽然推理效率高，但通常依赖大规模标注或合成生成的语料库。我们提出了CPIL（跨释义不变性学习），这是一个两阶段的孪生网络框架，它无需获取额外的事实性标签，即可将小规模标注集转化为关系型监督信号。CPIL从同一文档-声明实例的多个保持标签不变的释义视图中构建正样本对，并从与同一源文档相关联的相反标签示例中构建负样本对。该方法进一步引入了分位数感知的半难负样本挖掘策略，从正样本对的相似度分布中推导出一个边界……
tldr: 提出CPIL两阶段孪生框架，通过跨释义不变性学习将少量标注数据转化为关系型监督，并引入分位数感知的半难负样本挖掘策略，在不获取额外事实性标签的情况下实现标签高效的文档事实性检测。
